title: Post16 Results - main file
$comment: One row per result. LAESTAB is deliberately absent: it groups the supplier file into one blob per school and is dropped from the output, which leaves each record exactly the shape StudentResultRecord reads. SOURCE carries no column in the CSV either - the processor stamps it from the dataset slot the file was uploaded to (#324), and the schema must declare it or AllowAdditionalProperties would reject the stamped record.

CYPMD_ID.description: Student index number used in the checking exercise.

QUAL_NAME.description: Qualification title as the results file gives it, abbreviated.

GRADE.description: Grade awarded, on the scale the qualification uses.

SOURCE.description: Provenance tag, stamped from the dataset slot rather than read from the file.
